notes.title: Evolved Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
Kingspray has EVOLVED!

Update now for a tonne of FREE new features!

PAINT OVERHAUL
Take to the streets with a new and improved paint system, subtle and accurate pressure control, new caps, wet/dry simulation and realistic splatter effects! We have drastically improved your ability to fade and feather your work, as well as achieve tight lines using 5 new caps tweaked and refined for your satistfaction!

METALLICS! AND IRONLAK COLORS!
Kingspray now offers Metallic paints, turn any colour you like into a stunning metallic from our new and improved user interface, or select from a range of approved Ironlak Colours, including their popular range of Metallics!

NEW PAINT LOCATIONS!
We have added a slew of new locations notably the Subway, an eerie and abandoned station with a huge paint surface and dozens of hidden secrets! We've also added heaps of new Sandbox locations, from the new Long Wall and Tall Wall (HUGE SURFACES) to giant Spray Cans, and even a Baseball Cap!

DIRECTOR SYSTEM!
Present your work and keep spectators dazzled using our new automated camera system, it will track you and your work whilst placing it in our beautiful environments, adding mood and interest on your secondary display while you work away uninterrupted! This feature is great for streaming or recording your replays to edit and share, we can't wait to see what you create with it!

CUSTOM MUSIC!
Direct Kingspray to your desired media folder (or your default music library) to access your own music from the Boom Box!

NEW INTERACTABLES!
We've added heaps of new interactable items for you to discover and annoy your friends with! Keep an eye out for the new Adjustable Scaffolding (For those hard to reach spots), the 360 Camera (ready to share 360 Panoramas), and even a working Hetch-A-Sketch!

A massive thank you to all of the talented and awesome folks who have been enjoying Kingspray, we are so grateful and excited to share this new evolution with you!

For a full list of features, visit InfectiousApe.com or check the store page!

notes.title: Patch #1 is here!
notes.content:
Again we are really thankful of all the suggestions and feedback we have got so far.

We have done our best to address as many as possible in the first patch.

Left Hand Support
Cross platform Multiplayer
Undo / Redo - System (No lag / memory fix)
Quick menu pop out (A new menu for easily accessing Undo / Redo , Paint Colors and pressure. Tilt your wrist forwards to open. A massive improvement to usability!
Menu item options more visible of state (Bug fix with cursor resetting)
Pressure slider
Can shake vibration
Playback x1,x2,x4 speed
New Color picker, cycle between color graphs.
Can scrolling uses UI tracer to scroll.
Projector, everyone gets one! (Oprah) No physics so you can bump it anymore.
Work-light / 360 camera and scissor lift now use pointer ui to activate
Sample colors from wall into your quick picks, have the color picker open.
Radio volume adjusted, get those tunes pumping!
Torch added to left controller menu button, help is now accessed via the phone menu.
+ a bunch of polish and fixes
